SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(soi.amount) FROM sales_order so INNER JOIN sales_order_item soi ON so.id = soi.order_id WHERE so.status = 1 AND so.order_date = CURDATE()), 0) as today_sales,
COALESCE((SELECT SUM(soi.amount) FROM sales_order so INNER JOIN sales_order_item soi ON so.id = soi.order_id WHERE so.status = 1 AND so.order_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')), 0) as month_sales,
COALESCE((SELECT SUM(poi.amount) FROM purchase_order po INNER JOIN purchase_order_item poi ON po.id = poi.order_id WHERE po.status = 1 AND po.order_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')), 0) as month_purchase,
COALESCE((SELECT SUM(soi.amount) FROM sales_order so INNER JOIN sales_order_item soi ON so.id = soi.order_id WHERE so.status = 1 AND so.order_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(poi.amount) FROM purchase_order po INNER JOIN purchase_order_item poi ON po.id = poi.order_id WHERE po.status = 1 AND po.order_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')), 0) as month_profit,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expense_form WHERE status = 1) as pending_approval_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory i INNER JOIN product p ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE p.min_stock IS NOT NULL AND i.quantity < p.min_stock) as low_stock_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE status = 1) as product_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE status = 1) as customer_count
